label: CrewAI
description: The workflow becomes a native CrewAI flow: a method for each block, chained with @start, @listen and @router, with CrewAI Agents for the AI blocks and Crew blocks for teams of agents with tasks. Any catalog model works. Runs need CrewAI installed on the server (`make crewai`); designing and exporting do not. No saved history, state editing or breakpoints; a paused run lives in memory.

notes.core.set: a flow method that returns the fields it sets
notes.core.router: a @router method that picks the route with the same CEL rules
notes.core.join: a method that listens with and_() for every branch
notes.core.llm: a call to a CrewAI LLM
notes.core.agent: a CrewAI Agent (role, goal from the instructions, tools, structured output); asking before a tool call is not available yet
notes.core.approval: the flow stops with CrewAI's HumanFeedbackPending and continues from the saved fields when a person answers
notes.core.human_input: the flow stops with CrewAI's HumanFeedbackPending and asks again when an answer does not fit
notes.core.script: your workspace function is called from the flow
notes.knowledge.search: the flow searches the knowledge base; exports search its file with the built-in embedder
notes.mw.model_call_limit: becomes the agent's max_iter (model calls in one run of the agent); a per-conversation limit is not kept
